daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are giving clarity and spontaneity—your words hit different today. There's a magnetic pull toward new conversations and fresh perspectives. Lean into that wanderlust energy, even if it's just mentally.
daily.love: Venus is whispering about authenticity over performance. If you're coupled up, real talk about your actual needs lands beautifully. Single? Your genuine self is the ultimate flex right now. No filters needed.
daily.career: Your creative instincts are sharp—trust that gut feeling about a project or approach. This is your moment to pitch something unconventional. The universe is backing your boldness, so go forth with confidence.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not obligatory. Whether it's dancing, hiking, or just stretching, tune into what brings you joy. Energy flows where intention goes, and yours is seeking freedom.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about reclaiming your narrative, Sag. Venus is giving you permission to be unapologetically yourself, and honestly? The universe is backing it. Trust the timing of things unfolding.
weekly.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, there's a softness moving through your connections. Someone might surprise you with their vulnerability. Let your guard down too—real intimacy lives in the messy, honest moments.
weekly.career: Your ideas are sharper than usual, and people are actually listening. Don't sleep on that project brewing in your mind. This is a solid week to pitch, propose, or pivot. Your confidence is your actual superpower.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more intentional movement and rest—not punishment workouts or restrictive vibes. Dance, walk, stretch, whatever makes you feel alive. Mental clarity follows when you honor what your energy actually needs.
